meta.source: Beyond Service content doc + UI/UX audit, reviewed 2026-10-11; updated 2026-10-12 for strict palette compliance.
meta.palette: Charcoal + champagne. No blue, green, neon or multicolour gradients.
meta.notes: Light (cream) is the primary theme. Dark (charcoal) is the alternate for hero sections, dark CTAs and the full-page dark mode.
meta.paletteCompliance: All UI surfaces, text, borders and accents resolve to the 9 approved base colours (#0A0B0C, #17191A, #292C2E, #62676A, #AEB3B5, #F3F4F3, #FFFFFF, #B99A63, #D0B37B) or their alpha variants. Status tokens (success, error, warning) use accessible functional colours and are only applied to form feedback and validation. Hover for accent surfaces aliases the other approved champagne shade. Pressed state is handled with transform and opacity in the component layer rather than a token swap.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Deepest ink. Base of charcoal theme; strongest heading colour on cream.

tokens.name: ink-800
tokens.usage: Charcoal surface. Primary dark panel colour.

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Raised surface in dark theme; secondary body text in light theme.

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Muted text, meta labels, inactive icons.

tokens.name: ink-300
tokens.usage: Dividers, disabled states, placeholder text on cream.

tokens.name: ink-100
tokens.usage: Cream canvas. Primary surface in light theme; primary text in dark theme.

tokens.name: ink-000
tokens.usage: Pure white. Elevated card surface in light theme.

tokens.name: champagne-500
tokens.usage: Core brand accent. CTAs, highlights, focus ring on cream.

tokens.name: champagne-300
tokens.usage: Lighter champagne. Used as the primary accent on charcoal surfaces.

tokens.name: surface-canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. Every page starts here.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Card and panel surface. Default elevation above canvas.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset surface for input fields and subtle wells. Light theme: ink-800 at 5% alpha over cream. Dark theme: resolves to canvas, so inputs there rely on border for separation.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Mirror of the canvas. Dark panels on light pages (hero, dark CTAs), light panels on dark pages.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Modal and image overlays. ink-900 at 70% alpha, consistent across themes.

tokens.name: surface-scrim
tokens.usage: Hero image scrim so headlines stay legible over photography. ink-900 at 40% (light) or 65% (dark).

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Faintest divider. 10% ink.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Card borders, input borders. 20% ink.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Strong divider for section boundaries. 40% ink.

tokens.name: border-accent
tokens.usage: Accent border on featured cards, hover accents, selected states.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings and primary body text.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary body text and descriptions.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, meta, timestamps, form helpers.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text that sits on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, inline accent spans, link hover.

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Default link colour. Underlined on hover with champagne.

tokens.name: accent-primary
tokens.usage: Primary CTA fill, focus rings, key markers.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state. Swaps between the two approved champagne shades: light theme lifts to the lighter champagne, dark theme deepens to the richer champagne.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Soft champagne wash for highlighted cards and badges. 10% alpha.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline. 2px solid + 2px offset from the element.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Form success state. Used sparingly, never as a decorative colour.

tokens.name: status-success-soft
tokens.usage: Success banner background.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Form validation error, destructive action text.

tokens.name: status-error-soft
tokens.usage: Error banner background.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Non-blocking warnings. Note: visually close to champagne; keep context clear.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Hero headline. One per page, maximum.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Hero supporting copy. Section dek beneath a headline.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Longform paragraph on service detail pages.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense content, card bullets, footer copy.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Image captions, image credits, inline notes.

styles.name: button-lg
styles.usage: Hero CTA and quote form submit.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrows, uppercase. Pair with champagne text-accent.

tokens.name: space-2

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Default control inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard component gap. Card inner padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Comfortable component gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding and content block gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section inner padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Medium block spacing. Service card inner padding (desktop).

tokens.name: space-12

tokens.name: space-16

tokens.name: space-20

tokens.name: space-24

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Hero spacing and showpiece sections.

tokens.name: space-40

tokens.name: radius-sm

tokens.name: radius-2xl

tokens.name: radius-pill

tokens.usage: Hairline lift on hover for small elements.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Default resting card elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Card hover and raised panels.

tokens.name: shadow-lg

tokens.name: shadow-xl

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
